payload.reason: The evidence provides specific existing approaches related to learning vector space embeddings of geographic locations and using word embedding models for Points-of-Interest (POIs).

claims.text: One approach involves learning vector space embeddings of geographic locations using meta-data from photo-sharing websites, which improves on existing methods when structured information is available.
Another approach uses word embedding models to learn representations of Points-of-Interest (POIs) based on sequences of user visits, treating locations as words in a sentence.
